skills.name: Alabaster Lords' Pull
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Alabaster Lord's Pull

Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in.

Has a greater area of effect than Gravitas.

skills.name: Ancient Lightning Spear
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Ancient Lightning Spear

Imbue the armament with the ancient dragons' red lightning, then throw it as a spear.

Can be charged to increase its power.
skills.info: Imbue the armament with red lightning, then throw it as a spear. Can be charged to increase its power.

skills.name: Angel's Wings
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Angel's Wings

Jump and imbue the wing-blade of the armament with light, then deliver a slashing attack on the enemy.

The white wings impede recovery actions using a flask of tears.
skills.info: Jump and imbue the blade with light, then deliver a slashing attack upon the enemy.

skills.name: Assassin's Gambit

Skill: Assassin's Gambit

Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps.

skills.name: Barbaric Roar

Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
skills.info: Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.

skills.name: Barrage
skills.caption:
Skill: Barrage

Archery skill using a bow held horizontally.

Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
skills.info: Hold a bow horizontally, then fire off a rapid succession of shots.

skills.name: Barricade Shield
skills.caption:
Skill: Barricade Shield

Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt.

Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows.
skills.info: Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows.

skills.name: Bear Witness!
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Bear Witness!

Grant the small dragon a fleeting glimpse of life and thrust it skyward, spewing flames over a wide frontward area.
skills.info: Spew the flames of a small dragon over a wide frontward area.

skills.name: Beast's Roar
skills.caption:
Skill: Beast's Roar

Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile.
skills.info: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile.

skills.name: Black Flame Tornado
skills.caption:
Skill: Black Flame Tornado

Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames.

Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament.
skills.info: Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament.

skills.name: Blade of Death
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Blade of Death

Unleash the power of the Rune of Death to fire off a blade-like projectile.

skills.info: Unleash the power of the Rune of Death to fire off a blade-like projectile. The blade reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a while.

skills.name: Blade of Gold
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Blade of Gold

Leap into the air, charging the armament with golden flames that are then shot at the enemy as a single, blade-like projectile.

Inflicts holy damage.
skills.info: Leap into the air, shoot golden flames as a single, blade-like projectile.

skills.name: Blood Blade
skills.caption:
Skill: Blood Blade

Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging.

Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.info: Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.

skills.name: Blood Tax
skills.caption:
Skill: Blood Tax

Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood.

skills.info: Unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP.

skills.name: Bloodblade Dance
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Bloodblade Dance

Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks.

Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.
skills.info: Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks. Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.

skills.name: Bloodboon Ritual
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Bloodboon Ritual

Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the Formless Mother. Stab up to three times, creating explosions of blood with each thrust.

This skill will coat the armament with bloodflame for a while.
skills.info: Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the Formless Mother. Stab up to three times, creating explosions of blood with each thrust. This skill will coat the armament with bloodflame for a while.

skills.name: Bloodhound's Finesse
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Bloodhound's Finesse

Slash upwards with the Bloodhound's Fang, using the momentum of the strike to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes.

Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.
skills.info: Slash upwards to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.

skills.name: Bloodhound's Step
skills.caption:
Skill: Bloodhound's Step

This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets.
skills.info: Become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets.

skills.name: Bloody Slash

Skill: Bloody Slash

Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood.

From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc.
skills.info: Coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc.

skills.name: Braggart's Roar
skills.caption:
Skill: Braggart's Roar

skills.name: Bubble Shower

The bubbles float gently before raining down on the target.
skills.info: Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles. The bubbles float gently before raining down on the target.

skills.name: Buckler Parry

Skill: Buckler Parry

This is faster than a regular parry.

skills.name: Carian Grandeur

Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill.

skills.info: Quickly charge forward, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance.

skills.name: Chilling Mist

Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards.

skills.info: Coat armament in frost and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while.

skills.name: Claw Flick

skills.info: Cause the finger to swell, then flex to give enemies an almighty flick.

skills.name: Contagious Fury

skills.info: Forms a blade of cursed blood for repeated, interweaving successive attacks. Follow up with an additional input for further successive attacks.

skills.name: Corpse Wax Cutter

Lost skill of ancient heroes.

skills.info: Lift the sword up high to release the power of corpse wax and launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.

skills.info: Bury the armament in the ground, pulling rocks from the earth to reinforce it. Increases attack power and makes it easier to break enemy stance.

skills.name: Cursed-Blood Slice
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Cursed-Blood Slice

Brace, then charge forward to deliver a downward diagonal slice. The bloody trail of the blade is followed by a burst of flame.

skills.name: Destined Death

Set free the remnants of Destined Death, plunging the greatsword into the ground to summon a myriad of blades.

skills.name: Determination

skills.name: Double Slash

Ready the shield, then spray violent jets of fire from the tongues protruding from its maw.

Hold to continue spraying fire. This skill can be used while walking.
skills.info: Ready the shield, then spray violent jets of fire. Hold to continue spraying fire. This skill can be used while walking.

skills.name: Torch Attack
skills.caption:
Skill: Torch Attack

Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze.

This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
skills.info: Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze.

skills.name: Transient Moonlight
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight

Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.

Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.
skills.info: Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.

skills.name: Troll's Roar
skills.caption:
Skill: Troll's Roar

Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes.

Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.
skills.info: Let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.

skills.name: Unblockable Blade
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade

Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack.

This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.info: Imbue the blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Unblockable Blade
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade

Imbue the cipher blade with light, then lunge forward with a sudden piercing attack.

This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.info: Imbue the blade with light, then lunge forward with a sudden piercing attack. This attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Unsheathe
skills.caption:
Skill: Unsheathe

Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds.

Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.
skills.info: Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.

skills.name: Vacuum Slice
skills.caption:
Skill: Vacuum Slice

Lost skill of ancient heroes.

Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.
skills.info: Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.

skills.name: Viper Bite
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Viper Bite

Give the shield a quick shake to temporarily bring the bronze viper to life, inciting it to lash out and bite foes.
skills.info: Bring the bronze viper to life, inciting it to lash out and bite foes.

skills.name: Vow of the Indomitable
skills.caption:
Skill: Vow of the Indomitable

Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree.

Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility.
skills.info: Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility.

skills.name: War Cry
skills.caption:
Skill: War Cry

Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
skills.info: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.

skills.name: Waterfowl Dance
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Waterfowl Dance

Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo.

Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
skills.info: Perform a series of one-footed leaps to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

skills.name: Wave of Destruction
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Wave of Destruction

Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.
skills.info: Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.

skills.name: Wave of Gold
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Wave of Gold

Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes. A wide, golden wave fans out forwards, sweeping through all enemies caught in its path.
skills.info: Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes. A wide, golden wave fans out forwards.

skills.name: Waves of Darkness
skills.caption:
Skill: Waves of Darkness

Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness.

Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.
skills.info: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.

skills.name: White Shadow's Lure
skills.caption:
Skill: White Shadow's Lure

Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow.

The apparition lures in foes of human build, drawing their aggression. Effective regardless of combat state.
skills.info: Create a frontward-facing white shadow. The apparition lures in foes of human build, drawing their aggression.

skills.name: Wild Strikes
skills.caption:
Skill: Wild Strikes

Swing armament with wild abandon.

Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
skills.info: Swing armament with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.

skills.name: Wolf's Assault
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Wolf's Assault

Infuse the greatsword with frost, then perform a forward somersault to plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.
skills.info: Infuse the greatsword with frost, then leap forward and plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.

skills.name: Zamor Ice Storm
skills.caption:
Unique Skill: Zamor Ice Storm

Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.
skills.info: Plunge the curved sword into the ground and unleash a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.

spells.name: Adula's Moonblade
spells.caption:
Sorcery of Adula, the Glintstone Dragon.

Conjures a cold magic greatsword, then delivers a sweeping blow that launches a blade-like projectile of frost. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

Adula, a devourer of sorcerers, was bested by Ranni and subsequently swore a knightly oath to her Dark Moon.
spells.info: Conjures a cold magic greatsword and delivers a sweeping blow. At the same time, it launches a blade-like projectile of frost. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Agheel's Flame
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the flying dragon Agheel.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew flaming breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be used while jumping.

The dead gazed at the skies over the lakes of Limgrave, praying that the dragons' flames would burn them to ash.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew flaming breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be used while jumping.

spells.name: Ambush Shard
spells.caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Launches a projectile from a distance removed from the caster, so as to strike the enemy from behind. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

The Sellian sorcerers were assassins, and it is said that they often hunted their fellows.
spells.info: Launches a projectile from a distance removed from the caster, so as to strike the enemy from behind. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Ancient Death Rancor
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Summons a horde of vengeful spirits that chase down foes. Charging enhances potency.

They are cinders of the ancient death hex, raked from the fires of ghostflame by Deathbirds.
spells.info: Summons a horde of vengeful spirits that chase down foes. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear
spells.caption:
A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Creates a spear of red lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning covering the area.

Spoken of in legend, red lightning is the weapon wielded by the ancient dragons.
spells.info: Creates a spear of red lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning covering the area.

spells.name: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike
spells.caption:
A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons a red bolt of lightning that scatters and spreads around the surrounding area. Charging enhances the range of the lightning bolt.

Spoken of in legend, red lightning is the weapon wielded by the ancient dragons.
spells.info: Summons a red bolt of lightning that scatters and spreads around the surrounding area. Charging enhances the range of the lightning bolt.

spells.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Creates a throat pouch on the caster's neck, allowing them to spew fiery breath while walking. Charging increases duration of the breath.

This is a manifestation of the Erdtree's primal vital energies—an aspect of the primordial crucible, where all life was once blended together.
spells.info: Creates a throat pouch on the caster's neck, allowing them to spew fiery breath while walking. Charging increases duration of the breath.

spells.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Creates a mighty horn on the caster's shoulder to gore foes from a low stance. Charging allows the caster to barrel into foes before delivering the final attack.

This is a manifestation of the Erdtree's primal vital energies—an aspect of the primordial crucible, where all life was once blended together.
spells.info: Creates a mighty horn on the caster's shoulder to gore foes from a low stance. Charging allows the caster to barrel into foes before delivering the final attack.

spells.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Creates a supple tail that sweeps through foes before the caster. Charging enhances potency.

This is a manifestation of the Erdtree's primal vital energies—an aspect of the primordial crucible, where all life was once blended together.
spells.info: Creates a supple tail that sweeps through foes before the caster. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Barrier of Gold
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Erdtree Worship.

Greatly increases magic damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

This incantation was used by the champions of the Erdtree in the First and Second Liurnian Wars, during which the red-haired Radagon joined the heroes' ranks.
spells.info: Greatly increases magic damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Beast Claw
spells.caption:
Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Creates beast claws that rend the land with shockwaves. Charging enhances potency.

This incantation represents the fury of Gurranq, his bestial nature returned, as much as it does his restless agitation.
spells.info: Creates beast claws that rend the land with shockwaves. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Bestial Sling
spells.caption:
Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Swiftly flings a number of sharp rock shards. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

It is said that in the time before the Erdtree, stones were the first weapons of the beasts who had gained intelligence.
spells.info: Swiftly flings a number of sharp rock shards. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

spells.name: Bestial Vitality
spells.caption:
Incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Fills the body with bestial vigor, restoring HP over a period of time.

Having gained intelligence, the beasts must have felt how their wildness slipped away as civilization took hold.
spells.info: Fills the body with bestial vigor, restoring HP over a period of time.

spells.name: Black Blade
spells.caption:
Power gleaned from the remembrance of Maliketh.

Caster creates an illusory black blade, then leaps forward to deliver a spinning slash that emits a wave of light. This can be followed up with one additional attack.

This blade was once imbued with Destined Death. In addition to dealing damage, it reduces foes' maximum HP and continues to sap their current HP for a very short time.
spells.info: Creates an illusory black blade and emits a wave of light. This can be followed up with one additional attack.

spells.name: Black Flame
spells.caption:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Throws a ball of raging black fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the fireball to explode.

Black flame is weighty. After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time.
spells.info: Throws a ball of raging black fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the fireball to explode.

spells.name: Black Flame Blade
spells.caption:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Engulfs armament held in the right hand with black flame. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

Black flame is weighty. After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time.
spells.info:
Engulfs armament held in the right hand with black flame. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Black Flame Ritual
spells.caption:
Superior black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Summons a circle of black flame pillars around the caster. Charging increases the size of the circle.

The Gloam-Eyed Queen led the apostles. It is said that she was an Empyrean chosen by the Fingers.
spells.info: Summons a circle of black flame pillars around the caster. Charging increases the size of the circle.

spells.name: Black Flame's Protection
spells.caption:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Summons black fire within, increasing physical damage negation. However, sacred flasks and other such forms of HP restoration are impaired.

The Apostles were all embraced by the Gloam-Eyed Queen, and the black flame was their armor within.
spells.info: Summons black fire within, increasing physical damage negation. However, sacred flasks and other such forms of HP restoration are impaired.

spells.name: Blessing of the Erdtree
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Grants a greater blessing to the caster and nearby allies, gradually restoring a large amount of HP. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

The Erdtree once flourished with abundance—yet it was only for a fleeting moment. Such is the course of all life.
spells.info: Grants a greater blessing to the caster and nearby allies, gradually restoring a large amount of HP. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Blessing's Boon
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Grants a blessing to the caster and nearby allies, gradually restoring HP. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

Blessings once fell like tears from the Erdtree, and this incantation is but a lingering remnant of their power.
spells.info: Grants a blessing to the caster and nearby allies, gradually restoring HP. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Bloodboon
spells.caption:
Sacred incantation of Mohg, Lord of Blood.

Thrust arm into the body of the Formless Mother, then scatter the bloodflame to set the area ablaze. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The mother of truth craves wounds. When Mohg stood before her, deep underground, his accursed blood erupted with fire, and he was besotted with the defilement that he was born into.
spells.info: Scatter the bloodflame of the Formless Mother frontwards to set the area ablaze. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Bloodflame Blade
spells.caption:
A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood.

Engulfs armament held in the right hand with bloodflame. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

After dealing damage, bloodflame continues to build up onset of blood loss for a very short time.
spells.info:
Engulfs armament held in the right hand with bloodflame. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Bloodflame Talons
spells.caption:
A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood.

Creates bloodflame lacerations before the caster, which explode in an instant. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

After dealing damage, bloodflame continues to build up onset of blood loss for a very short time.
spells.info: Creates bloodflame lacerations before the caster, which explode in an instant. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Borealis's Mist
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Borealis, the Freezing Fog.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew icy breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

The ice dragons were once lords of the mountaintops long ago, until they were defeated by the Fire Giants and chased from the peak.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew icy breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

spells.name: Briars of Punishment
spells.caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals. Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with thorns of punishment, sending a trail of bloodthorns running over the ground to impale enemies from below. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.
spells.info: Wounds the caster with thorns of punishment, sending a trail of bloodthorns running over the ground. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Briars of Sin
spells.caption:
An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals. Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy.

Wounds the caster with thorns of sin, creating a spiral of bloodthorns. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly, up to three times.

The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.
spells.info: Wounds the caster with thorns of sin, creating bloodthorns. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly, up to three times.

spells.name: Burn, O Flame!
spells.caption:
One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Raises a series of flame pillars around the caster. Charging further increases the number of flame pillars.

The Fire Giants borrowed from the power of a fell god, and still they were defeated. Yet their failure released them from their solitary curse: to serve as keepers of the Flame for eternity.
spells.info: Raises a series of flame pillars around the caster. Charging further increases the number of flame pillars.

spells.name: Cannon of Haima
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency.

Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
spells.info: Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Carian Greatsword
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.
spells.info: Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Carian Phalanx
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Creates a defensive arch of numerous magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. This sorcery can be used cast while in motion.

An enhanced version of the glintblade sorcery used by enchanted knights.
spells.info: Creates a defensive arch of numerous magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. This sorcery can be used cast while in motion.

spells.name: Carian Piercer
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Conjures a magic greatsword to impale foes. Charging lengthens the initial step in.

This sorcery forms a counterpart to Carian Greatsword. Highly lethal when used against single foes riding alone.
spells.info: Conjures a magic greatsword to impale foes. Charging lengthens the initial step in.

spells.name: Carian Retaliation
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Swing your staff to dispel incoming sorceries and incantations, using their power to retaliate with glintblades.

This was the Carian royal family's secret means to prepare against the disloyalty of the academy. The moon and stars would one day go their separate ways.
spells.info: Dispels incoming sorceries and incantations, using their power to retaliate with glintblades.

spells.name: Carian Slicer
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Conjures a magic sword and delivers a swift sweeping slash. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

Even among the Carian sword sorceries, this is a notably effective technique.
spells.info: Conjures a magic sword and delivers a swift sweeping slash. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

spells.name: Catch Flame
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy.

Momentarily sparks flame from the caster's hand. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.
spells.info: Momentarily sparks flame from the caster's hand. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

spells.name: Collapsing Stars
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Fires numerous gravitational projectiles. Any foes struck will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency.

A gravitational technique mastered by the young Radahn. "I thank you for your tutelage, for now I can challenge the stars."
spells.info: Fires numerous gravitational projectiles. Any foes struck will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Comet
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

The greatest of the Karolos Conspectus's sorceries, that only a very few sorcerers have ever mastered.
spells.info: Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Comet Azur
spells.caption:
Legendary sorcery devised by Azur, primeval sorcerer.

Fires a tremendous comet in a torrent akin to the distant starry expanse, the place said to be the origin of glintstone. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power.

When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.
spells.info: Fires a tremendous comet. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power.

spells.name: Crystal Barrage
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires a volley of glintstone crystal shards. Charging increases potency.

A sorcery of the Crystal Cadre, a group of sorcerers who pursue the wisdom of stone—the secrets locked in the faint cogitation of the Crystalians.
spells.info: Fires a volley of glintstone crystal shards. Charging increases potency.

spells.name: Crystal Burst
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging increases potency.

A sorcery of the Crystal Cadre, a group of sorcerers who pursued the wisdom of stone—the secrets locked in the faint cogitation of the Crystalians.
spells.info: Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging increases potency.

spells.name: Crystal Release
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it to scour a wide area with a violent rain of crystal shards.

This sorcery is used by high-ranking adepts among the Crystalians. Some also call this sorcery "the Crystal Sun."
spells.info: Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it to scour a violent rain of crystal shards.

spells.name: Crystal Torrent
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Creates a mass of crystal, then fires off shards in rapid succession. Hold to continue firing shards.

The wrath of the Crystalians encapsulated in sorcery. Each shard is of substantial size, making even a stray blow capable of inflicting a severe wound.
spells.info: Creates a mass of crystal, then fires off shards in rapid succession. Hold to continue firing shards.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the assassins of the Roundtable Hold.

Creates a veil of darkness that conceals the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The assassins were themselves once Tarnished who had strayed from guidance, and they pursued their duty in the darkness that is without grace.
spells.info: Creates a veil of darkness that conceals the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Death Lightning
spells.caption:
Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Fortissax, now corrupted by Death.

Strikes surroundings with a storm of Death lightning. Inflicts Death blight upon foes. Charging extends duration of the storm.

It said that this golden lightning was wielded by Godwyn, who befriended Fortissax.
spells.info: Strikes surroundings with a storm of Death lightning. Inflicts Death blight upon foes. Charging extends duration of the storm.

spells.name: Discus of Light
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Produces a ring of light and fires it forwards. The ring of light returns to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
spells.info: Produces a ring of light and fires it forwards. The ring of light returns to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Divine Fortification
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases holy damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me—the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
spells.info: Increases holy damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons lightning to bolster the caster's body. Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced.

Only those loved by dragons can survive the ordeal of cladding their bodies in lightning.
spells.info: Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced.

spells.name: Dragonclaw
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to tear through foes with dragon claws. Allows one follow-up attack.

Incantation of those who have hunted dragons and feasted upon their hearts. Theirs is a pure and overwhelming power.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to tear through foes with dragon claws. Allows one follow-up attack.

spells.name: Dragonfire
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew flaming breath. Charging extends duration.

Incantation of those who have hunted dragons and feasted upon their hearts. Theirs is a pure and overwhelming power.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew flaming breath. Charging extends duration.

spells.name: Dragonice
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew icy breath. Charging extends duration.

Those extraordinary individuals who perpetuate Dragon Communion are called the dragon-hearted.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew icy breath. Charging extends duration.

spells.name: Dragonmaw
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to bite enemies before them.

Incantation of those who have hunted dragons and feasted upon their hearts. Theirs is a pure and overwhelming power.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to bite enemies before them.

spells.name: Ekzykes's Decay
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

Ekzykes, Dragon Communion Revenger, did not forget his hatred even as he succumbed to the scarlet rot.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

spells.name: Elden Stars
spells.caption:
This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.

Creates a stream of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

It is said that long ago, the Greater Will sent a golden star bearing a beast into the Lands Between, which would later become the Elden Ring.
spells.info: Creates a stream of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

spells.name: Electrify Armament
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with lightning-affinity attacks.

Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe—an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.
spells.info:
Enchants armament held in the right hand with lightning-affinity attacks.

This incantation can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Erdtree Heal
spells.caption:
One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.

Heals a vast amount of HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

The Erdtree once flourished with abundance—yet it was only for a fleeting moment. Such is the course of all life.
spells.info: Heals a vast amount of HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Eternal Darkness
spells.caption:
Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Creates a space of darkness that draws in sorceries and incantations. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Originally a lost sorcery of the Eternal City; the despair that brought about its ruin made manifest.
spells.info: Creates a space of darkness that draws in sorceries and incantations. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Explosive Ghostflame
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Strike the ground with the staff, triggering an explosion of ghostflame that burns the surrounding area.

In the time when there was no Erdtree, death was burned in ghostflame. Deathbirds were the keepers of that fire.
spells.info: Triggers an explosion of ghostflame that burns the surrounding area.

spells.name: Fire's Deadly Sin
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from a deeply ominous prophecy.

Sets both the caster and the surrounding area ablaze with raging flames. The caster's body will remain engulfed in flame for a while, burning them and any who draw near. Charging enhances potency.

The prophet despaired, looking up at the Erdtree, for soon the kindling would burst into flame, bringing ruin.

"The burning of the Erdtree is the first cardinal sin. That is not the domain of mere men."
spells.info: Sets both the caster and the surrounding area ablaze with raging flames. The caster's body will remain engulfed in flame for a while, burning them and any who draw near. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Flame Fortification
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases fire damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me—the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
spells.info: Increases fire damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Flame of the Fell God
spells.caption:
This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze.

Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.
spells.info: Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting them ablaze.

spells.name: Flame Sling
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy.

Throws a ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode.

The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.
spells.info: Throws a ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode.

spells.name: Flame, Fall Upon Them
spells.caption:
One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Hurls several balls of fire at once. Charging enhances potency and causes the balls of fire to explode.

There is no record of this incantation in common prayerbooks. Only a select few prelates know of its existence.
spells.info: Hurls several balls of fire at once. Charging enhances potency and causes the balls of fire to explode.

spells.name: Flame, Grant Me Strength
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

Creates an invigorating fire within that enhances physical and fire-affinity attack power.

This incantation does not burn the caster, and so it is considered forbidden by the guardians of the Flame.
spells.info: Creates a fire within that enhances physical and fire-affinity attack power.

spells.name: Flame, Protect Me
spells.caption:
The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.

Creates a fire within that greatly increases fire damage negation.

It is said that this incantation was used during the War against the Giants long ago, during which it protected the champions of the Erdtree.
spells.info: Creates a fire within that greatly increases fire damage negation.

spells.name: Fortissax's Lightning Spear
spells.caption:
Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Fortissax.

Creates two spears of red lightning and stabs them into the ground from above, one after another. On impact, each spear will burst into trails of lightning covering the area.

During the War of the Ancient Dragons, these twin red lightning stakes were the hallmark of one ancient dragon who was called the mightiest boulderstone.
spells.info: Summons two spears of red lightning and stabs them into the ground from above, one after another. On impact, each spear will burst into trails of lightning covering the area.

spells.name: Founding Rain of Stars
spells.caption:
The eldest primeval sorcery, said to have been discovered by an ancient astrologer. A sorcery of legendary status.

Summons a dark cloud of stars overhead. Shortly after, the cloud will release a violent deluge of star rain. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging increases potency.

Thought to be the founding glintstone sorcery. The glimpse of the primeval current that the astrologer saw became real, and the stars' amber rained down on this land.
spells.info: Releases a violent deluge of star rain for a time. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging increases potency.

spells.name: Freezing Mist
spells.caption:
Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

Releases a cold mist before the caster. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist.

The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.
spells.info: Releases a cold mist before the caster. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist.

spells.name: Frenzied Burst
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Releases concentrated blasts of the yellow flame of frenzy from the caster's eyes. Charging enhances potency, enabling the blasts to penetrate the enemy's guard.

In times past, every single person who attempted to control the flame of frenzy succumbed to madness after a desperate internal struggle. This incantation is testament to a meager victory.
spells.info: Releases concentrated blasts of the yellow flame of frenzy from the caster's eyes. Charging enhances potency, enabling the blasts to penetrate the enemy's guard.

spells.name: Frozen Armament
spells.caption:
Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with frost. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.
spells.info:
Enchants armament held in the right hand with frost. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Frozen Lightning Spear
spells.caption:
Incantation that channels the power of the Dragonkin Soldiers.

Creates a spear of ice lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning advancing forwards.

The Dragonkin were born in the Eternal City, where they knew no true sky, nor true lightning. Instead, ice lightning was their weapon.
spells.info: Creates a spear of ice lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning advancing forwards.

spells.name: Gavel of Haima
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Creates a magical greathammer and slams it down. Allows one follow-up attack.

Drawn from the scholarly conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
spells.info: Creates a magical greathammer and slams it down. Allows one follow-up attack.

spells.name: Gelmir's Fury
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Conjures a surge of magma from the earth, covering the area. Charging extends the surge of magma.

This sorcery is held to represent the fury of the volcano, but the arrogance of attempting to harness it is solely that of men and serpents.
spells.info: Conjures a surge of magma from the earth, covering the area. Charging extends the surge of magma.

spells.name: Giantsflame Take Thee
spells.caption:
One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Hurls a massive ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode.

There is no record of this incantation in common prayerbooks. Only a select few prelates know of its existence.
spells.info: Hurls a massive ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode.

spells.name: Glintblade Phalanx
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Creates a defensive arch of magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Bestowed upon the enchanted Carian knights, who combined this art with their swordsmanship to maintain pressure upon their foes, striking in waves of steel and sorcery.
spells.info: Creates a defensive arch of magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Glintstone Arc
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

Granted to sorcerers who depart from the academy to embark on journeys, in order to fend off large groups of would-be adversaries. Fools often roam in packs.
spells.info: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

spells.name: Glintstone Breath
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath. Charging extends duration.

Those extraordinary individuals who perpetuate Dragon Communion are called the dragon-hearted.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath. Charging extends duration.

spells.name: Glintstone Cometshard
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.
spells.info: Fires a magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Glintstone Icecrag
spells.caption:
Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching a mass of cold magic. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.
spells.info: Launches a mass of cold magic. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

spells.name: Glintstone Pebble
spells.caption:
The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

This is a universal first step on the journey to true knowledge of sorcery.
spells.info: Launches magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

spells.name: Glintstone Stars
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires three magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

A sorcery of the Olivinus Conspectus, which attracts sorcerers from Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
spells.info: Fires three magic shooting stars. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Golden Lightning Fortification
spells.caption:
An incantation of Erdtree Worship.

Greatly increases lightning damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying, delaying the effect.

This incantation was used by the knights of the Erdtree during the assault by the great ancient dragon Gransax, and the bitter War of the Ancient Dragons that followed.
spells.info: Greatly increases lightning damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying, delaying the effect.

spells.name: Golden Vow
spells.caption:
An incantation of Erdtree Worship.

Increases attack power and damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

This incantation has been taught to knights of the royal capital for generations, and knights sent on distant expeditions lean on it as a source of courage.
spells.info: Increases attack power and damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Gravity Well
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Fires a projectile of condensed gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency.

A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.
spells.info: Fires a gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Great Glintstone Shard
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
spells.info: Launches large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

spells.name: Great Heal
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Greatly heals HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

The Two Fingers has high hopes for the Tarnished; that even if they should be wounded, even should they fall, they will continue to fight for their duty.
spells.info: Greatly heals HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Great Oracular Bubble
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Produces a gigantic magical bubble that drifts towards foes before it naturally ruptures. Charging increases the delay before the bubble pops.

The claymen search for lost oracles within their bubbles.
spells.info: Launches a gigantic magical bubble. Charging increases the delay before the bubble pops.

spells.name: Greatblade Phalanx
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes.

Used by the enchanted troll knights. They were the comrades of the young Rennala, bound by oath.
spells.info: Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes.

spells.name: Greyoll's Roar
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.

Transforms caster into a dragon to emit a terrible roar, reducing the attack power and damage negation of nearby enemies.

Greyoll was the mother of all dragons, dwarfing all who stood before her like a looming mountain.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to emit a terrible roar, reducing the attack power and damage negation of nearby enemies.

spells.name: Gurranq's Beast Claw
spells.caption:
Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Creates beast claws that rend surroundings with shockwaves.

Long ago, Gurranq was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his former name meant "Death of the Demigods."
spells.info: Creates beast claws that rend surroundings with shockwaves.

spells.name: Heal
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Heals HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

The Two Fingers has high hopes for the Tarnished; that even if they should be wounded, even should they fall, they will continue to fight for their duty.
spells.info: Heals HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Honed Bolt
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons a bolt of lightning to strike foes from above. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe—an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.
spells.info: Summons a bolt of lightning to strike foes from above. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Howl of Shabriri
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Releases a maddening shriek that causes madness buildup in self and those nearby, making enemies more likely to target caster. This incantation also boosts the caster's attack power at the expense of lower damage negation.

It is said that the sickness of the flame of frenzy began with Shabriri, the most reviled man in all history.
spells.info: Releases a maddening shriek that causes madness buildup in self and those nearby, making enemies more likely to target caster. Boosts attack power while lowering damage negation.

spells.name: Immutable Shield
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Enchants shield held in the left hand with the light of regression, increasing all forms of non-physical damage negation and ailment resistance.

Two concepts form the basis for Golden Order fundamentalism. One is the law of regression, to which this incantation relates.
spells.info:
Enchants shield held in the left hand with the light of regression, increasing all forms of non-physical damage negation and ailment resistance.

This incantation can only be cast with the right hand.

spells.name: Lansseax's Glaive
spells.caption:
Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Lansseax.

Creates a red-lightning glaive and sweeps the area from above. This attack unleashes trails of lightning.

Lansseax was the sister of Fortissax. It is said that she took the form of a human to commune with the knights as a priestess of the ancient dragon cult.
spells.info: Creates a red-lightning glaive and sweeps the area from above. This attack unleashes trails of lightning.

spells.name: Law of Causality
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals.

Manifests a small ring of causality within that allows the caster to automatically retaliate upon receiving a certain number of blows.

The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Causality is the pull between meanings; that which links all things in a chain of relation.
spells.info: Automatically retaliate upon receiving a certain number of blows.

spells.name: Law of Regression
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals.

Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms.

The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.
spells.info: Heals all negative statuses and dispels special effects.

spells.name: Lightning Fortification
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases lightning damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me—the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
spells.info: Increases lightning damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Lightning Spear
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point of impact.

Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe—an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.
spells.info: Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point of impact.

spells.name: Lightning Strike
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons a bolt of lightning that scatters and spreads around the surrounding area. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

Ancestors of the modern dragons, the ancient dragons had scales of Gravel Stone and wielded lightning as their weapon. It is said that once they attacked Leyndell, the Royal Capital.
spells.info: Summons a bolt of lightning that scatters and spreads around the surrounding area. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Litany of Proper Death
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Creates an image of Order, dealing holy damage to nearby foes. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason—all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
spells.info: Creates an image of Order, dealing holy damage to nearby foes. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

spells.name: Lord's Divine Fortification
spells.caption:
Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two Fingers.

Greatly increases holy damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

Gideon gained true knowledge after his long exchange with the Two Fingers—discovering all had been broken long ago; that the trembling fingers, bent with age, and the Erdtree itself, were no exception.
spells.info: Greatly increases holy damage negation for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Lord's Heal
spells.caption:
Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished deemed worthy of becoming a lord.

Heals a massive amount of HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

Tarnished—O, Tarnished! Seek the Erdtree and stand before Marika, its Queen. Become the Elden Lord!
spells.info: Heals a massive amount of HP for the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Loretta's Greatbow
spells.caption:
Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta.

Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked.

It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon.
spells.info: Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked.

spells.name: Loretta's Mastery
spells.caption:
Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked.

Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace.
spells.info: Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked.

spells.name: Magic Downpour
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

Summons a mass of magic that fires projectiles over a wide area. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging extends duration.

Said to have been taught by the Crystalians to mark the swearing of the old concord.
spells.info: Summons a mass of magic that fires projectiles. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging extends duration.

spells.name: Magic Fortification
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me—the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
spells.info: Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Magic Glintblade
spells.caption:
An old sorcery of the Carian royal family.

Creates a sigil overhead, from which an enemy-seeking glintblade appears after a brief delay. This sorcery can be used while in motion. Charging increases the delay.

Said to be the prototype of the sword-phalanx sorceries wielded by royal enchanted knights.
spells.info: Creates a sigil overhead, from which an enemy-seeking glintblade appears after a brief delay. This sorcery can be used while in motion. Charging increases the delay.

spells.name: Magma Breath
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a wyrm to spew magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack.

Those who have performed the Dragon Communion will find their humanity slowly slipping away. Once they fully succumb to their fate, they are left no more than wyrms that crawl the earth.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a wyrm to spew magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack.

spells.name: Magma Shot
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Fires a lump of magma that explodes on contact. Charging enhances potency.

After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
spells.info: Fires a lump of magma that explodes on contact. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Meteorite
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Summons a void that emits a rain of small meteorites. Hold to continue the effect.

This sorcery originates from the Onyx Lords, who had skin of stone, and were called lords in reverential fear of their destructive power.
spells.info: Summons a void that emits a rain of small meteorites. Hold to continue the effect.

spells.name: Meteorite of Astel
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect.

A manifestation of the power with which Astel leveled the Eternal City.
spells.info: Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect.

spells.name: Night Comet
spells.caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Fires a semi-invisible magic comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

The Sellian sorcerers were assassins, and it is said that they often hunted their fellows.
spells.info: Fires a semi-invisible magic comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Night Maiden's Mist
spells.caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Releases a life-sapping silver mist before the caster, dealing damage to all caught within, including the caster. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Below Sellia, the Eternal City of Nokron sleeps. This sorcery originates from the maidens of that place.
spells.info: Releases a mist before the caster, dealing damage to all caught within, including the caster. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Night Shard
spells.caption:
One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Swiftly fires a semi-invisible projectile. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

The Sellian sorcerers were assassins, and it is said that they often hunted their fellows.
spells.info: Swiftly fires a semi-invisible projectile. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

spells.name: Noble Presence
spells.caption:
Ancient power of the Godskin Nobles.

Thrust out belly with gusto to produce a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging enhances potency, knocking enemies into the air.

Once a sign of the gods' wrath, this incantation became a trophy of the Nobles' god hunt.
spells.info: Thrust out belly with gusto to produce a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging enhances potency, knocking enemies into the air.

spells.name: O, Flame!
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Fire Monks.

Momentarily sparks roaring flame from the caster's hand. Charging enhances potency.

The Giants' Flame still smolders upon the distant northern mountaintop, and the Fire Monks are its guardians.
spells.info: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from the caster's hand. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Oracle Bubbles
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.

Produces several small magical bubbles that drift towards foes before they naturally pop. Charging increases the delay before the bubbles pop.

The claymen search for lost oracles within their bubbles.
spells.info: Launches several small magical bubbles. Charging increases the delay before the bubbles pop.

spells.name: Order's Blade
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason—all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
spells.info: Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived. Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Pest Threads
spells.caption:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Secretes countless sticky threads, launching them forwards.

A technique of the pale pests who crawl through the lands afflicted by scarlet rot; the abandoned children of the goddess.

"Do you have an interest in rot incantations?"
spells.info: Secretes countless sticky threads, launching them forwards.

spells.name: Placidusax's Ruin
spells.caption:
Power gleaned from the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.

Transforms caster into the Dragonlord to spew golden breath from above. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

These are the dying wails of the Dragonlord who once dwelled eternally beyond time.
spells.info: Transforms caster into the Dragonlord to spew golden breath from above. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

spells.name: Poison Armament
spells.caption:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
spells.info:
Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Poison Mist
spells.caption:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Releases a poisonous mist before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
spells.info: Releases a poisonous mist before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Protection of the Erdtree
spells.caption:
A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship.

Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
spells.info: Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

spells.name: Radagon's Rings of Light
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A gift of gratitude to the young Miquella from his father, Radagon.

Produces a golden ring of light and fires it across a wide area. Charging enhances range.

And yet, the young Miquella abandoned fundamentalism, for it could do nothing to treat Malenia's accursed rot. This was the beginning of unalloyed gold.
spells.info: Produces a golden ring of light and fires it across a wide area. Charging enhances range.

spells.name: Rancorcall
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes. Charging enhances potency.

Once thought lost, this ancient death hex was rediscovered by the necromancer Garris.
spells.info: Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
spells.caption:
Legendary sorcery symbolic of the Carian queen.

Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a cold, dark moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The dark moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes.

This moon was encountered by a young Ranni, led by the hand of her mother, Rennala. What she beheld was cold, dark, and veiled in occult mystery.
spells.info: Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a cold, dark moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The dark moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes.

spells.name: Rejection
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Produces a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

Hark, Tarnished! If you truly walk in faith, you must be prepared to reject all else.
spells.info: Produces a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

spells.name: Rennala's Full Moon
spells.caption:
Sorcery symbolic of the Carian queen.

Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes.

Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.
spells.info: Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes.

spells.name: Rock Blaster
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a massive magical shockwave.

Hold to continue moving without striking the ground, and then push the end of the staff into enemies.

An enhanced version of the glintstone miners' Stonedigger sorcery.
spells.info: Pierce the ground and create a massive magical shockwave. Hold to keep a magic ferrule oriented forwards that can be smashed into enemies.

spells.name: Rock Sling
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

Pulls a clump of rocks from the earth and sends them flying. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.
spells.info: Pulls a clump of rocks from the earth and sends them flying.

spells.name: Roiling Magma
spells.caption:
One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion.

After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
spells.info: Fires a lump of magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion.

spells.name: Rotten Breath
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath. Charging extends duration.

Those extraordinary individuals who perpetuate Dragon Communion are called the dragon-hearted.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath. Charging extends duration.

spells.name: Rykard's Rancor
spells.caption:
The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Summons searing spirits that leave a trail of delayed explosions in their wake.

These spirits manifest from the rancor of heroes who met a violent end. The lord granted them an audience, whereupon they were welcomed by the maw of the great serpent—and within the serpent's bowels, they became the lord's kin.
spells.info: Summons searing spirits that create a series of explosions after a delay.

spells.name: Scarlet Aeonia
spells.caption:
Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.

Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot.

Each time the scarlet flower blooms, Malenia's rot advances. It has bloomed twice already. With the third bloom, she will become a true goddess.
spells.info: Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot.

spells.name: Scholar's Armament
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with magic-affinity attacks. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Taught to the Knights of the Cuckoo by the academy as payment for their contract.
spells.info:
Enchants armament held in the right hand with magic-affinity attacks. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Can only be cast with the left hand.

spells.name: Scholar's Shield
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Enchants shield held in the left hand with additional damage negation. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Taught to the Knights of the Cuckoo by the academy as payment for their contract.
spells.info:
Enchants shield held in the left hand with additional damage negation. This sorcery can be cast while in motion.

Can only be cast with the right hand.

spells.name: Scouring Black Flame
spells.caption:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range.

The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
spells.info: Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range.

spells.name: Shadow Bait
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the assassins of the Roundtable Hold.

Creates a pale gold shadow before the caster, luring foes of human build and attracting their aggression. This incantation can be cast while in motion, and will still affect foes that are already in a combat state.

It is said that those beguiled by the shadow see within it a hated foe.
spells.info: Creates a pale gold shadow before the caster, luring foes of human build. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Shard Spiral
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
