Fires twin projectiles that form a spiral as they travel. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy. This was the product of a failed attempt to create a new comet.
spells.info: Fires twin projectiles that form a spiral as they travel. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Shatter Earth
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack.

A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.
spells.info: Pierce the ground and create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack.

spells.name: Shattering Crystal
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency.

The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.
spells.info: Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Smarag, the Glintstone Dragon.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

Smarag was a devourer of sorcerers, and over time, his body became corrupted by their glintstones.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

spells.name: Star Shower
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.
spells.info: Fires six magic shooting stars. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency.

spells.name: Stars of Ruin
spells.caption:
Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerer.

Fires twelve dark shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging increases potency.

When Lusat glimpsed into the primeval current, he beheld the final moments of a great star cluster, and upon seeing it, he too was broken.
spells.info: Fires twelve dark shooting stars. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging increases potency.

spells.name: Stone of Gurranq
spells.caption:
Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Hurls a boulder before the caster. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

Long ago, Gurranq was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his former name meant "Death of the Demigods."
spells.info: Hurls a boulder before the caster. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Storm Ruler
spells.caption:
Unique Skill: Storm Ruler

A legendary skill discovered while confronting the Nightlord. Readying weapon gathers the power of the storm. Attacking unleashes the whirling tempest.
spells.info: Readying weapon gathers the power of the storm. Attacking unleashes the whirling tempest.

spells.name: Storm Ruler
spells.caption:
Unique Skill: Storm Ruler

A legendary skill discovered while confronting the Nightlord. Readying weapon gathers the power of the storm. Attacking unleashes the whirling tempest.
spells.info: Readying weapon gathers the power of the storm. Attacking unleashes the whirling tempest.

spells.name: Surge, O Flame!
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

Creates a stream of fire to burn the area before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to maintain the effect.

The Giants' Flame is the flame of ruin, capable of burning the Erdtree. And so, following the War against the Giants, its ruinous blaze was sealed, and guardians were appointed to watch over it.
spells.info: Creates a stream of fire to burn the area before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to maintain the effect.

spells.name: Swarm of Flies
spells.caption:
A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power.

Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
spells.info: Releases a swarm of bloodflies. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
spells.info: Launches swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action.

spells.name: Terra Magica
spells.caption:
One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, boosting the magic attacks of those within.

Once, the sigil would be cast from the highest belfry of the academy, covering the entire institution's grounds. This spell allows such vivid experience of spell-casting success, it turns many a fledgling into a true sorcerer in a flash of newfound understanding.
spells.info: Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, boosting the magic attacks of those within.

spells.name: The Flame of Frenzy
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to burst forth from the caster's eyes. Charging increases the range of the burst.

The flame of frenzy deals damage and causes buildup of madness. This incantation also causes buildup of madness in the caster, and is only effective against Nightfarers.
spells.info: Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to burst forth from the caster's eyes. Charging increases the range of the burst.

spells.name: Theodorix's Magma
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix.

Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack.

The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on—as a hero of the War against the Giants.
spells.info: Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack.

spells.name: Thops's Barrier
spells.caption:
The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

Creates a magic forcefield that deflects sorceries and incantations. Hold to continuously create barriers.

Future generations will learn. They will know the foolishness of the sneering sorcerers who ridiculed this theory, little realizing that it was in fact a discovery worthy of a new conspectus of the academy.
spells.info: Creates a magic forcefield that deflects sorceries and incantations. Hold to continuously create barriers.

spells.name: Tibia's Summons
spells.caption:
Sorcery of the servants of Death.

Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing.

The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.
spells.info: Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing.

spells.name: Triple Rings of Light
spells.caption:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
spells.info: Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

spells.name: Unendurable Frenzy
spells.caption:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion.

It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
spells.info: Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion.

spells.name: Urgent Heal
spells.caption:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Heals a small amount of HP. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The Two Fingers has high hopes for the Tarnished; that even if they should be wounded, even should they fall, they will continue to fight for their duty.
spells.info: Heals a small amount of HP. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

spells.name: Whirl, O Flame!
spells.caption:
Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

Creates a spiraling stream of fire that burns the area before the caster. Charging enhances potency and reach.

Fire beguiles those who gaze into it. And so the guardians of the Flame are also its worshippers.
spells.info: Creates a spiraling stream of fire that burns the area before the caster. Charging enhances potency and reach.

spells.name: Wrath of Gold
spells.caption:
Superior Erdtree Worship incantation.

Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

This incantation was discovered when the Elden Ring was shattered, and it was feared as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.
spells.info: Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

spells.name: Zamor Ice Storm
spells.caption:
Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

Strike the ground with the staff to create a freezing tornado. Charging enhances potency.

Cloaked in icy tempests, the knights of Zamor have challenged the Fire Giants since ancient times.
spells.info: Creates a freezing tornado surrounding the caster. Charging enhances potency.

items.name: Dismembered Finger
items.caption:
A finger torn from the Primordial Nightlord. Lacking the life-giving spark of blood, it is instead saturated with Night.

The Undertaker held a faint glimmer of hope. That she might finally shed the dreadful power that enshrouds her.

But she knew her hopes were only fantasies. And so she became determined to at least find comfort.

The Night was brought to an end, but the loathsome hex would be hers forever.

items.name: Cord End
items.caption:
A carefully woven cord.

This cord belonged to the young girls who were housed in a place that was meant as an eternal secret.

The cutting-gifted tribe vowed to sacrifice their flesh while concealing the truth. But the girls were too young to oblige.

items.name: Smithing Stone [3]
items.caption:
Smithing stone made by polishing a golden Gravel Stone. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula.

Use at a smithing table to strengthen rare armaments.

The Ancient Dragonlord's seat is said to lie beyond time. This stone lightly twists time, allowing the creation of a weapon capable of slaying a god.

items.name: Wending Grace
items.caption:
An afterglow of lost grace unleashed by the tide of Night.

Allows one to rise from defeat a single time. Will take effect when kept in possessions. Lost upon use.

The world crumbles. And yet light, forgetful of its own path, still seeks a follower to bestow guidance upon, summoning again grace once lost.
items.info: Rise from defeat a single time

items.name: Acid Spraymist
items.caption:
Forbidden art of depraved perfumers.

Releases an acidic mist from user's mouth that travels forwards, damaging armaments and temporarily lowering attack power.

Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.
items.info: Releases acidic mist and lowers attack

items.name: Ancestral Infant's Head
items.caption:
Skull of a very young ancestral spirit. Just think how many sproutings It might bear.

Uses FP to spray spirit vapor, inflicting magic damage.

The vapor becomes a temporary geyser which deals continuous damage to everything it touches until it disappears.
items.info: Uses FP to spray spirit vapor

items.name: Bloodboil Aromatic
items.caption:
Forbidden art of depraved perfumers.

Induces a temporary state of fervor, raising maximum attack power and stamina while also increasing damage received.

"Even upon the battlefield, do you fear being wounded? Take a good look. Your limbs are frozen stiff."
items.info: Raises attack but also damage received

items.name: Regal Omen Bairn
items.caption:
Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.

Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

Omen babies born of royalty do not have their horns excised, but instead are kept underground, unbeknownst to anyone, imprisoned for eternity.

These memorial fetishes are fashioned in secret.

items.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

This concoction explodes when consumed.

A defective crystal tear which possesses absolutely no medicinal qualities. A lesson said to be learned the hard way for some; faith can be a volatile matter, after all.

items.caption:
Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large shard which is semi-vitrified.

Use at a smithing table to strengthen uncommon armaments.

Thought to have been used to hone the weapons of the champions of the War against the Giants at the birth of the Erdtree.

items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Temporarily raises all resistances and heals all status ailments.

items.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Increases the power of charged attacks for a certain duration.
items.info: Enhances charged attacks for a time

items.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Makes one's attacks more likely to break enemy stances. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.
items.info: Attacks more ably break enemy stances

items.name: Stonesword Key
items.caption:
A sword-shaped stone key.

Breaks the seal on imp statues, but remains embedded in the statue after use, meaning it can only be used once as an item.

Think well before using one.
items.info: Use to break one imp statue seal but lost upon use

items.name: The Sister in the Painting
items.info: [Revenant] Acquire The Sister in the Painting garb

items.name: Thorny Cracked Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Makes consecutive attacks grow stronger the longer they continue. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Prevents one's runes from being lost upon death, as well as levelling down. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.
items.info: Temporarily stop rune loss on death

effects.name: No Rune Loss or Level Down Upon Death
No Rune Loss or Level Down Upon Death
No Rune Loss or Level Down Upon Death

items.name: Uplifting Aromatic
items.caption:
Art of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering.

Raises the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half.

This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.
items.info: Boosts attack power and reduces incoming damage once

items.name: Windy Crystal Tear
items.caption:
A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.

Increases the effectiveness of dodge rolls for a certain duration. However, damage taken is also increased during the concoction's effect.
items.info: Enhances dodging but increases damage taken

items.name: Xanthous
items.caption: Acquire Xanthous garb

items.name: Bewitching Branch
items.caption:
Tree branch blessed with an incantation of unalloyed gold.

Thrust branch forward to release a beguiling mist, entrancing foes such that they temporarily join your cause.

The Empyrean Miquella is loved by many people. Indeed, he has learned very well how to compel such affection.
items.info: Mist briefly makes allies of foes

items.name: Boiled Crab
items.caption:
Boiled crab meat. A prime specimen of plump and moist meat. True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting.

Greatly boosts physical damage negation for a certain duration.

Unlike the "prawn" sold, this truly is crab. Not that it matters, it's delicious all the same.
items.info: Greatly boosts physical damage negation for a time

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone
items.caption:
Lump of broken glintstone enwreathed with magic power. A "faux sorcery" used by the Knights of the Cuckoo.

Launched straight ahead. Magic bolts spring forth from the point of impact.
items.info: Throw to produce magic bolts on impact

items.name: Dragon Heart
items.caption:
Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. Riddled with Gravel Stone, this grotesque organ continues to beat vivaciously.

An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours.

While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.
items.info: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar

items.name: Exalted Flesh
items.caption:
A lump of animal flesh pickled in a medicinal solution mixed with fiery spices.

Temporarily boosts physical attack.

Considered a delicacy in the badlands, this invigorating repast was for the exclusive benefit of those who they deem heroes.

items.name: Fetid Pot
items.caption:
A cocktail of effluents sealed inside a pot. As the mixture ferments, toxins are produced alongside a putrid stench that seeps out once ripe.

Throw at enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison.

Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies.

Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.
items.info: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison

items.name: Freezing Pot
items.caption:
A pot engraved with the crest of the Carian Royals.

Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost.

Originates from the cold, dark moon of Ranni, the Carian princess.
items.info: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost

items.name: Gravity Stone Chunk
items.caption:
Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike. It is imbued with a particularly weighty magic.

Throw at enemies to cause a gravitational explosion.

The desperate ones who scavenge for these shards dub themselves "starcallers."
items.info: Throw at foe to cause a gravitational explosion

items.name: Gravity Stone Fan
items.caption:
Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike. It is imbued with a particularly weighty magic.

Throw near foes to make fan-shaped gravitational shockwave.

The desperate ones who scavenge for these shards dub themselves "starcallers."
items.info: Throw near foes to make fan-shaped gravitational shockwave

items.name: Ironjar Aromatic
items.caption:
Forbidden art of depraved perfumers.

Temporarily turns body to steel, boosting poise, resistances and damage negation at the expense of mobility and lightning resistance.

An art that requires fragments of hunted noble jars. Depraved perfumers are plainly in league with jar poachers.

items.name: Large Glintstone Scrap
items.caption:
Large piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels.

Crush gem to produce magic bolts.

Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.
items.info: Crush gem to produce many magic bolts

items.name: Omen Bairn
items.caption:
Doll of a curseborn bairn.

Uses FP to unleash wraiths that chase down foes.

Omen babies have all their horns excised, causing most to perish. These fetishes are made to memorialize them.

"Please, don't hate me, or curse me. Please."
items.info: Uses FP to unleash wraiths that chase down foes

items.name: Pickled Turtle Neck
items.caption:
Turtle neck meat, pickled in a bitter medicinal solution.

Temporarily boosts stamina recovery.

The nutrients churn through the body, practically boiling out endless power.

items.name: Poison Pot
items.caption:
A cocktail of poisonous materials sealed inside a pot.

Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.
items.info: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison

items.name: Poison Spraymist
items.caption:
Forbidden art of depraved perfumers.

Releases a poison mist from user's mouth that travels forwards, causing a buildup of poison.

Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.
items.info: Releases a poison mist that travels forwards

items.name: Rancor Pot
items.caption:
Pot enchanted by the ancient death hex.

Throw at enemies to spawn vengeful spirits that chase down foes.

In times of old, the dead were burned with ghostflame, and from those cinders arose vengeful spirits.
items.info: Throw at enemies to spawn vengeful spirits

items.name: Rot Pot
items.caption:
A pot decorated with the crest of scarlet wings.

Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.

The rot bubbles up from the Swamp of Aeonia, and eats away at life like a vicious plague.
items.info: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot

items.name: Sleep Pot
items.caption:
Pot enchanted by the incantations of St. Trina.

Throw at enemies to cause buildup of sleep.

Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, its light-purple haze irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.
items.info: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of sleep

items.name: Small Pouch
items.caption:
A handmade leather pouch gifted to departing travelers.

Increases item equip slots.

Any self-respecting adventurer will make ample use these helpful pouches that can keep an assortment of trusted tools within easy reach.

items.name: Smithing Stone [1]
items.caption:
Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A shard found in plenty throughout the Lands Between.

Use at a smithing table to strengthen common armaments.

Smithing stone is found throughout the Lands Between, and mining galleries built to excavate it can be found everywhere.

items.name: Spark Aromatic
items.caption:
Art of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering.

Broadly scatters sparks in a wide arc straight ahead.

Though fire was prohibited to those who served the Erdtree, this rule was forgotten as the war drew ever on.
items.info: Broadly scatter sparks in a wide area

items.name: Starlight Shards
items.caption:
An ephemeral sliver that gives off a pale blue glow. What remains of a passing flash of starlight.

Restores FP.

A prized item that was once used in the Eternal City as an ingredient in intoxicating draughts.

items.name: Swarm Pot
items.caption:
A cocktail of effluents sealed inside a pot.

Throw at enemies to set a swarm of bloodflies upon them. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. The cacophony of their wings assails the sanity of berserkers.

The maggots found in waste feed on blood and turn into vicious flies that are pitiably short-lived.
items.info: Throw to release a swarm of bloodflies

items.name: Volcano Pot
items.caption:
Powdered volcanic rock sealed inside a pot.

Throw at enemies to disperse a cloud of heat, dealing continuous damage to those caught inside for a short duration.
items.info: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous fire damage

items.name: Warming Stone
items.caption:
Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Two Fingers.

Generates warmth where activated, continuously restoring the HP of nearby allies.

It's said that the Erdtree was once as warm as the gentle sun, and would gradually heal all who bathed in its rays.

items.name: Wraith Calling Bell
items.caption:
Bell used by worshippers of revenants.

Ring bell, using FP to summon prowling wraiths. This can be done multiple times in a row.

Wraiths are said to be the vengeful spirits of those who died when cursed.
items.info: Uses FP to ring bell and calls prowling wraiths

items.name: Alluring Pot
items.caption:
Pot enchanted with assassin incantations.

Throw at enemies to create a pale shadow.

The illusion will lure in and distract foes of human frame.
items.info: Throw at enemies to lure human-build foes

items.name: Beastlure Pot
items.caption:
Pot enchanted with assassin incantations.

Throw at enemies to create a red shadow.

The illusion lures in beasts into attacking it.
items.info: Throw at enemies to lure beastly prey

items.name: Blood Grease
items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a mixture of blood-red materials.

Coats armament, inflicting blood loss. The effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Boiled Prawn
items.caption:
Boiled prawn meat. A prime specimen of plump and moist meat. True connoisseurs know how to keep from over-salting.

Boosts physical damage negation for a certain duration.

The meat actually looks to have come from a crayfish. Not that it matters, it's delicious all the same.
items.info: Boosts physical damage negation for a time

items.name: Bow
items.caption: A formal bow

items.name: By My Sword
items.caption: A threatening gesture

items.name: Clarifying Boluses
items.caption:
Yellow boluses made of cave moss.

Alleviates madness buildup. Also boosts resistance and gradually restores HP.

Madness accumulates slowly, inflicting heavy damage and reducing FP once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

items.name: Crystal Dart
items.caption:
Throwing knife chiseled from impure crystal.

Throw at enemies to deal magic damage.

Long ago, it is said that a golem crafter employed a similar crystal tool.
items.info: Throw at enemies to inflict magic damage

items.name: Dejection
items.caption: Rest on the floor

items.name: Dragonwound Grease
items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a gravel-stone mixture.

Coats armament, granting an anti-dragon effect and boosting physical attack. The effect lasts only for a short time.

When the dragons were born from their ancient kin, they lost their stone scales, which can now be used to cause them mortal harm.

items.name: Fan Daggers
items.caption:
A set of five throwing knives bundled together. A concealed weapon cherished by the raptor assassins.

The thin knives fan out when thrown, dealing damage to the target.

Each knife deals paltry damage, but the wide range makes it suitable for constraining enemies.
items.info: Throw fanned-out knives at enemies to inflict damage

items.name: Fire Grease
items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials.

Coats armament, adding fire damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Fire Pot
items.caption:
A cocktail of incendiary materials sealed inside a pot.

Throw at enemies to inflict fire damage.
items.info: Throw at enemies to inflict fire damage

items.name: Flask of Crimson Tears
items.caption:
A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of blessing.

Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Though currently empty, simply rest at a site of grace to replenish.

The one washed up on the gravesite was sure to die, until this flask offered its gift of rejuvenation. To seek the Elden Ring.
items.info: Restores HP, but is currently empty

items.name: Flask of Crimson Tears
items.caption:
A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of blessing.

Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. It will replenish itself after a period of time, but touching a Site of Grace will restore it immediately.

items.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot
items.caption:
Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a golden medicinal solution.

Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration.

Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.
items.info: Boosts rune acquisition for a time

items.name: Holy Grease
items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials.

Coats armament, adding holy damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Holy Water Pot
items.caption:
Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order.

Throw at enemies to inflict holy damage.

Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again.

The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.
items.info: Throw at enemies to inflict holy damage

items.name: Hoslow's Oath
items.caption: An inspiriting gesture

items.name: Jump for Joy
items.caption: Slump to the floor

items.name: Kukri
items.caption:
A large knife used for throwing. Its curved blade is sharp enough to slice flesh cleanly.

Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss.

This heavy throwing weapon is unsuitable for swift attacks, but is able to inflict heavy damage.
items.info: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss

items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials.

Coats armament, adding lightning damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Lightning Pot
items.caption:
A cocktail of fulminating materials sealed inside a pot.

Throw at enemies to inflict lightning damage.

Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials.

Coats armament, adding magic damage to attacks. The effect lasts only for a short time.

A cocktail of magically resonant materials sealed inside a pot. Called a "faux sorcery" in Raya Lucaria.

Throw at enemies to inflict magic damage.

items.caption: A reverential bow

items.name: Poisonbone Dart
items.caption:
Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing, with a poison-laced tip.

Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up poison.

items.caption: A stiff bow

items.caption:
Scarlet boluses made of cave moss.

items.name: Rallying Cry
items.caption: Pledge on one's sword

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses
items.caption:
Black boluses made of cave moss.

Alleviates death blight buildup. Also boosts resistance and gradually restores HP.

Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials.

Coats left-hand armament, boosting guarding ability and all forms of damage negation. The effect lasts only for a short time.

Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a silvery medicinal solution.

Temporarily boosts item discovery.

Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.

items.name: Soporific Grease
items.caption:
Solidified grease made from a mixture of light-purple materials.

Coats armament, inflicting sleep. The effect lasts only for a short time.

items.name: Stanching Boluses
items.caption:
Red boluses made from cave moss.

Alleviates impending blood loss. Also boosts resistance and gradually restores HP.

Blood loss escalates gradually, causing great damage once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

items.name: Stimulating Boluses
items.caption:
Light-purple boluses made from cave moss.

Alleviates buildup of sleep. Also boosts resistance and gradually restores HP.

Sleep accumulates gradually, causing sudden fogginess and loss of FP once the threshold is reached, even if it does not force the afflicted into true slumber.

Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.

items.name: Strength!
items.caption: Raise morale

items.name: Thawfrost Boluses
items.caption:
Ice-hued boluses made from cave moss.

Alleviates buildup of frost and cures frostbite ailment. Also boosts resistance and gradually restores HP.

Frost accumulates gradually, causing damage and inflicting frostbite once the threshold is reached. Vulnerability to damage increases for a certain duration.

items.name: Throwing Dagger
items.caption:
Short dagger for throwing. It has no handguard. The blade is polished, and its weight is expertly balanced.

Throw at enemies to deal damage.

This auxiliary weapon, used primarily to constrain an enemy's movements, can still be deadly in the right hands.
items.info: Throw at enemies to inflict damage

items.name: Wave
items.caption: A tough fist gesture

items.name: What Do You Want?
items.caption: A prayer borne of despair

talismans.name: Symbol of Avarice
talismans.caption:
Head of the avaricious creature that mimics treasure chests.

Increases runes obtained from defeated enemies as well as item discovery, but the curse of the branded also drains HP.

This creature's very shape is thought to be the result of a form branding—a punishment for sin.
talismans.info: Gain more runes, but lose HP

talismans.name: Ancestral Spirit's Horn
talismans.caption:
Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit.

Restore FP upon defeating enemies.

A number of new growths bud from the antler-like horns of the fallen king, each glowing with light. Thus does new life grow from death, and from death, one obtains power.

talismans.name: Godfrey Icon
talismans.caption:
A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Godfrey.

Raises charge attack power of sorceries, incantations, and skills.

Godfrey was a ferocious warrior. When he vowed to become a lord, he took the Beast Regent Serosh upon his back to suppress the ceaseless lust for battle that raged within.

talismans.name: Old Lord's Talisman
talismans.caption:
A legendary talisman depicting the ancient king whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time.

Extends the duration of sorceries and incantations.

It is said that the ancient royal city of Farum Azula has been slowly crumbling since time immemorial.

talismans.name: Radagon Icon
talismans.caption:
A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon.

Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.

As the husband of Rennala of Caria, the red-haired Radagon studied sorcery, and as the husband of Queen Marika, he studied incantations. Thus did the hero aspire to be complete.

talismans.name: Sacrificial Twig
talismans.caption:
A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.

Prevents rune loss upon death, and avoids levelling down, but the talisman itself will be lost in exchange.

Believed to be a twig pruned from the Erdtree long, long ago.
talismans.info: Runes are not lost upon death

talismans.name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting three arrows. Carried by hunters of beasts.

Increases the effective range of bows.

talismans.name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting three iron arrows. Carried by soldiers long ago.

Raises attack power of arrows and bolts.
talismans.info: Raises attack power of arrows and bolts

talismans.name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
talismans.caption:
An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean.

Critical hits restore FP.

This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of Death.

talismans.name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
talismans.caption:
An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson.

Critical hits restore HP.

This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of Death.

talismans.name: Axe Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting an axe and a warrior.

Enhances charge attacks.

The Lord who led the Long March bore an axe, and his loyal warriors honored him by wielding axes of their own, making them very effective at dealing decisive blows.

talismans.name: Blessed Dew Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a drop of the Erdtree's sap, a blessed boon.

Gradually restores HP.

It was once thought that the blessed sap of the Erdtree would drip from its boughs forever—but that age of plenty swiftly came to a close, and with time, the Erdtree became more an object of faith.

talismans.name: Blue-Feathered Branchsword
talismans.caption:
A talisman adorned with blue feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.

Raises damage negation when HP is low.

The heart sings when one draws close to death, and thus does one cling tenaciously to life—to render up a death worth offering.
talismans.info: Raises damage negation when HP is low

effects.name: Improved Damage Negation at Low HP

talismans.name: Boltdrake Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a yellow ancient dragon.

Boosts lightning damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Bull-Goat's Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting the horns of a bull-goat.

Raises poise.

Bull-goats are associated with the stout and mighty Tragoth, said to be unflinching in combat—now a silent comrade to those who fight.

talismans.name: Carian Filigreed Crest
talismans.caption:
A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

Lowers FP consumed by skills.

An honor said to have once been awarded to Carian knights who served as direct retainers to the kingdom's princesses. Now there is only one princess: Ranni, daughter of Rennala.

talismans.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
talismans.caption:
A medallion with cerulean amber inlaid. Boosts maximum FP.

The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

A primordial life energy resides inside.

talismans.name: Clarifying Horn Charm
talismans.caption:
An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers.

Raises focus. (Focus governs resistance to sleep and madness.)

Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

talismans.name: Claw Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a claw and an assassin.

Enhances jump attacks.

The assassins of Ravenmount are killers by trade. They assail their victims while dressed as birds of prey.

talismans.name: Companion Jar
talismans.caption:
A talisman given by the jars to their friends.

Raises potency of thrown jars.

Though the jars are brought to life by human flesh and blood, they are all rather kindly folk. Perhaps they were made to be better than their innards.

talismans.name: Crimson Amber Medallion
talismans.caption:
A medallion with crimson amber inlaid. Boosts maximum HP.

The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

A primordial life energy resides inside.

talismans.name: Crimson Seed Talisman
talismans.caption:
A crimson-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed.

Boosts HP restoration from the Flask of Crimson Tears.

The Erdtree was once perfect and eternal, and thus was it believed that Erdtree seeds could not exist.
talismans.info: Boosts HP restoration from Flask of Crimson Tears

talismans.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman fashioned from feathers that embody the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.

Improves the effectiveness of dodge rolls, but increases damage taken at all times.

A vestige of the crucible of primordial life. Born partially of devolution, it was considered a signifier of the divine in ancient times, but is now increasingly disdained as an impurity as civilization has advanced.
talismans.info: Improves dodge rolling but increases damage taken

talismans.name: Curved Sword Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a curved sword and a swordsman.

Enhances guard counters.

It is said that a blind swordsman was the originator of this technique—the art of allowing one's opponent to strike so as to leave them vulnerable to a well-timed reply.

talismans.name: Dagger Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a dagger and a surgeon.

Enhances critical hits.

The white-garbed field surgeons come to the aid of friend and foe alike by dealing a final deadly thrust to spare them from the prolonged agony of a mortal wound. A sense of mercy is a catalyst for bloodlust.

talismans.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
talismans.caption:
Wrought iron talisman depicting an ancient dragon.

Boosts physical damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Erdtree's Favor
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a special blessing of the Erdtree. Slightly raises maximum HP and stamina.

It is said that when the Age of the Erdtree began, such blessings were personally bestowed upon their recipients by Queen Marika herself.

talismans.name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a group of masked figures. Raises potency of incantations.

The figures represent the flock at prayer, their firm belief in the intangible inspiring even the solitary founder of their religion.

What is faith if not an affirmation?

talismans.name: Fire Scorpion Charm
talismans.caption:
A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that burns with fire.

Raises fire attack power, but lowers damage negation.
talismans.info: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation

talismans.name: Flamedrake Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a red ancient dragon.

Boosts fire damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
talismans.caption:
Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together.

Successive attacks restore HP.

The Gloam-Eyed Queen cradles newborn apostles swaddled in this cloth. Soon they will grow to become the death of the gods.

talismans.name: Gold Scarab
talismans.caption:
A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

This golden scarab increases the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies.
talismans.info: Increases runes obtained from defeated enemies

talismans.name: Graven-School Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a school of graven mages, the nightmare of the academy.

Raises potency of sorceries.

The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.

talismans.name: Greatshield Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a knight holding a greatshield.

Boosts guarding ability.

The knights of Leyndell once modelled themselves after the Tree Sentinels. Their purpose is to protect that which deserves protection, and thus the shield always comes before the sword.

talismans.name: Green Turtle Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman in the shape of a green turtle. Raises stamina recovery speed.

Turtles are known as a nutritious ingredient, symbolic of inexhaustible power.

However, those who hold turtles to be wise creatures consider the practice of eating their meat to be barbarous.

talismans.name: Haligdrake Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a golden ancient dragon.

Boosts holy damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Hammer Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a hammer and a knight.

Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against a blocking opponent.

Hammers are highly effective against shield-bearing foes, so much so that they are known as "knight-killers."

talismans.name: Immunizing Horn Charm
talismans.caption:
An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers.

Raises immunity. (Immunity governs resistance to poison and rot.)

Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

talismans.name: Kindred of Rot's Exultation
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting the exultation of pests.

Raises attack power when poisoning or rot occurs in the vicinity.

"Rot for the scarlet goddess. O scarlet blossoms, flourish in distant lands, and return to us, the unwanted children."
talismans.info: Poisoning or rot in vicinity increases attack power

talismans.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
talismans.caption:
A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that sparks with lightning.

Raises lightning attack power, but lowers damage negation.
talismans.info: Raises lightning attack, but lowers damage negation

talismans.name: Lord of Blood's Exultation
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood.

Raises attack power when blood loss occurs in the vicinity.

"Render up your offerings of blood to your Lord. Drench my consort's chamber. Slake his cocoon's thirst. His awakening shall herald the dawn of our dynasty."
talismans.info: Blood loss in vicinity increases attack power

talismans.name: Magic Scorpion Charm
talismans.caption:
A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.

Raises magic attack power, but lowers damage negation.
talismans.info: Raises magic attack, but lowers damage negation

talismans.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
talismans.caption:
Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft.

Boosts dexterity and raises attack power with successive attacks.

The despair of sweet betrayal transformed Millicent from a mere bud into a magnificent flower. And one day, she will be reborn—as a beautiful scarlet valkyrie.
talismans.info: Boosts dexterity, raises attack power with successive attacks

talismans.name: Mottled Necklace
talismans.caption:
A vividly-colored accoutrement precious to the ancestral followers.

Raises immunity, robustness, and focus.

Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

talismans.name: Pearldrake Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon.

Boosts non-physical damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Perfumer's Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles.

Raises potency of arts employing perfume.

There are gardens known only to the perfumers. Whether hidden on the fringes of the highlands, or obscured by shadows inside caves, the flowers blossom in secret, waiting to impart their scent.
talismans.info: Raises potency of arts employing perfume

talismans.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
talismans.caption:
An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.

Reduces FP consumption of sorceries and incantations at the cost of maximum HP.

The old sorcerers would slice open their hearts with these blades to imbue a primal glintstone with their soul, and thus did they die.
talismans.info: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

talismans.name: Prince of Death's Pustule
talismans.caption:
A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh.

Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

It is said that this pustule came from the visage of the Prince of Death, he who used to be called Godwyn. As First Dead of the demigods, it's said he's buried deep under the capital, at the Erdtree's roots.

talismans.name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
talismans.caption:
A talisman adorned with red feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.

Raises attack power when HP is low.

The heart sings when one draws close to death, and a glorious end awaits those who cling tenaciously to life.
talismans.info: Raises attack power when HP is low

effects.name: Improved Attack Power at Low HP

talismans.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

Raises damage negation when HP is at maximum.

The practice had died out by the age of King Consort Radagon, but remains of the arenas where ritual combat took place can still be found in every land.
talismans.info: Raises damage negation when HP is at maximum

effects.name: Improved Damage Negation at Full HP

talismans.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.

Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

The practice had died out by the age of King Consort Radagon, but remains of the arenas where ritual combat took place can still be found in every land.
talismans.info: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum

effects.name: Improved Attack Power at Full HP

talismans.name: Roar Medallion
talismans.caption:
A bronze medallion depicting a roaring giant.

Enhances roars and breath attacks.

In ancient times, the giants were mortal enemies of the Erdtree. Their bellowing roars desolated nature, triggered avalanches, and whipped up storms of flame.

talismans.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
talismans.caption:
A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.

Raises holy attack power, but lowers damage negation.
talismans.info: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation

talismans.name: Silver Scarab
talismans.caption:
A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

This silver scarab enhances item discovery.

talismans.name: Spear Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier.

Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.

Spears are standard weapons for soldiers in the Lands Between. They made it possible to respond to a ferocious foe with an equally ferocious counterattack.
talismans.info: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

talismans.name: Spelldrake Talisman
talismans.caption:
Talisman depicting a blue ancient dragon.

Boosts magic damage negation.

The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections.

talismans.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
talismans.caption:
An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers.

Raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.)

Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

talismans.name: Taker's Cameo
talismans.caption:
A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.

Restores HP upon defeating enemies.

When Rykard turned to heresy, taking by force became the rule. The gods themselves were no different, after all.

talismans.name: Twinblade Talisman
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor.

Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.

The twinblade technique is a tradition of the confessors, who closely guard the secret of how they preserve the momentum of their attacks. Thus is the final strike of their onslaught all the more deadly.
talismans.info: Enhances final hit of chain attacks

talismans.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
talismans.caption:
A medallion with viridian amber inlaid. Boosts maximum stamina.

The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

A primordial life energy resides inside.

talismans.name: Warrior Jar Shard
talismans.caption:
Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

Boosts the attack power of skills.

Scraps of stewed flesh cling to the shard, and tatters of ornaments can be seen mingled within the slime. Relics of ancient royal warriors, perhaps.
talismans.info: Boosts the attack power of skills

talismans.name: Winged Sword Insignia
talismans.caption:
A talisman depicting a raised prosthetic blade. An honor bestowed upon the knights who fought alongside Malenia the Severed.

Raises attack power with successive attacks.

The wings symbolize Malenia and her undefeated prowess. Though she never knew relief from the accursed rot she was born into, her blade was forever beautiful—and relentless.
talismans.info: Raises attack power with successive attacks
